answer: Resist sybils with a braided work-history thread: trust is earned task by task. First, a new identity starts hollow, capped at microtasks under $1 until it proves itself. Second, each completed job adds a signed receipt from a different client to its thread, verified against the work. Third, full rights unlock only after 50 receipts from 20 distinct clients over 21 days. One proven fraud snaps the thread and forfeits a $60 bond. To forge 10,000 identities takes 500,000 fake jobs, $600,000 in bonds, and 210,000 days of labor. Like a rope, one strand snaps, but a braided thread holds.
